Diagnosis.submission: The cleanup-controller deployment in namespace hotel-reservation is failing continuously with HTTP 403 Forbidden. It watches for terminating ConfigMaps carrying the finalizer cleanup.reservations.io/pending-cleanup (currently the ConfigMap reservation-cleanup-token) and tries to remove that finalizer via a PATCH request to the Kubernetes API. However, the ClusterRole configmap-cleanup-controller bound to its ServiceAccount (cleanup-controller) only grants get/list/watch on configmaps and is missing the patch/update verb. As a result every reconciliation is denied with 403 and the ConfigMap reservation-cleanup-token is stuck in Terminating indefinitely (deletionTimestamp set, finalizer never removed). Root cause: insufficient RBAC permissions for the cleanup-controller (missing patch/update on configmaps).
